about: The crop–origin registry (Supply outlook foundation, E151): one entry per crop the platform models. life_cycle is the crop's biology — alternate bearing (perennial fruit and nut trees and vines: a heavy crop drains the tree, the next is light) decides whether the bearing cycle is removed before a calibration; annual crops are only detrended. A crop's origins are not listed here: they are every country FAOSTAT reports production for (data/reference/faostat_crops.json). A crop not in this registry is refused, never guessed. eurostat_crop is the crop's code in Eurostat apro_cpsh1 (EU-27, EFTA, UK, candidate countries); where a source's definition differs from FAO's it is stated in eurostat_label, never silently mixed. fas_commodity is the crop's USDA FAS PSD commodity code; fas_label states where FAS's definition differs from FAO's (milled rice, oils, shelled almonds) — series from different sources are never mixed.
provenance: life cycles carried from ml/features/crop_cycle.ALTERNATE_BEARING_CROPS (2026-08-16, the finding that removing a spurious cycle from annual crops strips real climate variance)

crops.fas_label: Oil, Olive — the OIL; FAO reports olives

Rice, MILLED basis — FAO reports paddy
